method.complexity: Actual installed ESLint classic complexity rule, threshold zero, on compiled JavaScript AST; function node ranges retained. No estimated branch count.
method.coverage: Exact V8 function start/end matching. Union observed executions across processes; most-specific V8 range wins. Split at every observed range boundary; conservative coverage is min(executed segment fraction, executed byte fraction). Missing observations are NOT_MEASURED.
method.formula: CRAP = CC^2 * (1 - coverage)^3 + CC; hard limit 50, target 10.
method.limitations: V8 range-segment coverage is not Istanbul statement/branch coverage. Unobserved branch boundaries cannot be inferred. Built-source hashes are recorded at measurement time; V8 JSON does not contain a source hash, so caller must ensure unchanged build during collection. Nested callbacks are measured separately. NOT_MEASURED is not a pass.
